sources.setup: plain BDS, superflat survival world, difficulty easy, naturalregeneration false; two bds-sweep-client players; the subject stands at (0.5,-60,0.5) inside a glass tank whose interior (-1..1, -60..-58, -1..1) the console fills with water or air
same world and tank, one client; game mode, effect, /damage and /kill phases
same world and tank, one client; /setblock of a solid block at eye height

packets: hex of the packet header and payload (no length prefix), as recorded by client_diff

spawn.note: Join: the initial SetActorData (no BREATHING, air 300/300), then one tick after PlayStatus(PlayerSpawn) a flags-only update setting BREATHING. Nothing else while idle on land.

short_dive.note: Eyes submerged by /fill water: BREATHING cleared with air 299, then air -1 per tick; drained by /fill air: BREATHING set with air +4 in the same tick, then +4 per tick, clamped to 300.

short_dive_viewer.note: The same short dive as received by a second player next to the subject.

drown_and_surface.note: Air runs out and goes negative; each time it would reach -20 the tick sends ActorEvent hurt (data 9, drowning), air 0 and health -2. Six hits, then drained right after a hit: air 4 with BREATHING.

drowning_death_and_respawn.note: Starting at health 8: three hits, then the killing hit sends ActorEvent death (no hurt) and a SetActorData with air 0 (plus death keys 53/54/129). After respawn: BREATHING with air 300.

surface_at_negative_air.note: Drained while air was -9 (before the first hit): air resets to 0 with BREATHING that tick (no +4), then +4 per tick.

creative_mid_dive.note: Creative while submerged at air 200: BREATHING and +4 per tick under water up to 300; back to survival still submerged: BREATHING cleared, air 299 and falling; then drained.

water_breathing_mid_dive.note: Water breathing given while submerged: as creative. Effect cleared: BREATHING cleared, air falls again.

conduit_power_mid_dive.note: Conduit power given while submerged: as water breathing.

spectator_mid_dive.note: Spectator while submerged: as creative, with HAS_COLLISION off in the flag word. The flags-only updates BDS sends with each UpdatePlayerGameType (seq 6092, 6293) belong to the game-mode change and are left out.

hurt_causes.note: /damage 1 with causes fall, lava, entity_attack, magic, drowning, void (suffocation was refused): the hurt event data is the damage cause id.

land_death_and_respawn.note: /kill on land at full air: no air or flag update at death or after respawn.

head_in_solid.note: Stone, then glass, then oak leaves set at eye height for 3 s each: no air or flag update; BDS shrinks the player to crawl height instead (box height key 54 and a second-word flag, key 92).
